observations.body: Fire consumes the incense offerers, their censers are hammered over the altar as a warning, and Aaron’s incense stands between living and dead during plague.
observations.label: Censers become altar covering after rebellion

observations.body: The passage presents unauthorized incense, memorial metal, plague, priestly action, and atonement as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: unauthorized incense, memorial metal, plague, priestly action, and atonement

observations.body: The passage places rebellion and intercession beside unauthorized incense, memorial metal, plague, priestly action, and atonement.
observations.label: rebellion and intercession

payload.posture: Read Numbers 16:35–50 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the same object moves from condemned use to memorial covering under divine instruction
